# MDN011 `old-style-array-constructor`

<Badge type="warning" text="warning" /> <Badge type="tip" text="enabled by default" />

An array constructor written `(/ ... /)` instead of `[ ... ]`.

## Why

The square-bracket form has been standard since Fortran 2003; it is shorter and does not look like
a division. Fixable automatically (`fobis lint --fix`).

## Reported

```fortran
a = (/ 1, 2, 3 /)
```

## Preferred

```fortran
a = [1, 2, 3]
```

## Suppressing

For one occurrence, with the reason on the same line (or alone on the line before the statement):

```fortran
! fobis: ignore[MDN011] <why this occurrence is fine>
```

For the whole project, `ignore = MDN011` in the fobos [`[lint]` section](/cookbook/analysis#choose-the-rules).

## Equivalent

Fortitude rule `MOD011` (see [Lint Rules](/lint-rules/#relation-to-fortitude)).
